blocks.text: By the end of this chapter, students will be able to :

items: Evaluate how different stakeholders' cultures, values, and sometimes conflicting interests affect AI system designs, and assess policies that protect stakeholders' interests.
Design innovative applications relevant to Pakistan using emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Cloud Computing, and Blockchain.

blocks.text: In this chapter, students will explore the applications of computer science through emerging technologies. They will learn about Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its use in everyday applications such as voice assistants, chatbots, and image recognition, along with its benefits and challenges. The chapter introduces the Internet of Things (IoT) and how connected devices collect and share data for automation. The chapter highlights the cultural and ethical implications of AI, including fairness, transparency, and the role of different stakeholders. Students will examine how emerging technologies can be applied to solve national challenges in Pakistan, with a focus on innovative solutions like smart agriculture. Finally, they will learn about policies, regulations, and responsible innovation, emphasizing the importance of ethical and sustainable use of technology.
